## Purpose and user-visible behavior

Explain the problem solved, and how to use the result from a clean public clone.

## Change classification

- [ ] Adapter / integration
- [ ] Hermes tool / agent workflow
- [ ] Tests / bug fix
- [ ] Documentation / developer experience

## Required checks

- [ ] No direct push to main or request to merge into the competition baseline
- [ ] Local test command, result, platform and exact tested commit SHA provided below
- [ ] Tested failure behavior (timeouts, unavailable backend, malformed output)
- [ ] Tenant/identity isolation reviewed where relevant
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials, private packages, private endpoints or customer data
- [ ] Upstream projects, dependencies and licenses identified
- [ ] Setup and executable example included
- [ ] Real behavior distinguished from mocks, placeholders, and future work
